title: Lip Filler–Related Nodules
html: I congratulate Drs. Bagheri and Kimm (Bagheri Z, Kimm H. Lip Filler–Related Granulomatous Inflammation Mimicking Oral Pathology: A Case Report. JADA. Published online July 29, 2026. doi:10.1016/j.adaj.2026.05.009) on highlighting the clinically challenging filler-related granulomas (FRGs). However, excision seems unnecessary, given the characteristic manifestation and recognized delayed inflammatory reactions (IRs) to fillers.
